stories.title: Flintshire council says Buckley pond fish not in undue distress after inspection
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council says the fish in Higher Common Pond at Buckley are not in undue distress, and has ruled out refilling the pond while the drought lasts. stories.title: Met Office issues thunderstorm warning covering Flintshire from Wednesday evening
stories.summary: A Met Office yellow warning for thunderstorms covers Flintshire from 7pm on Wednesday until 10am on Thursday. The warning was issued at 10:17 on Wednesday morning and also covers Wrexham, Denbighshire, Conwy, Gwynedd, Anglesey, Cheshire West and Chester, and much of north west England. stories.title: Shotton loses its Sayers this weekend as owner moves to shut 19 shops
stories.summary: The Sayers bakery in Shotton will close on Saturday 22 August, staff have told a town councillor, as the chain’s owner proposes to shut 19 shops. stories.title: Reform UK disowns Facebook page named for Alyn and Deeside over Ukraine post
stories.summary: Reform UK says a Facebook page named for Alyn and Deeside and Wrexham is not official, after it carried a post calling for an end to support for Ukraine. The post, published on Monday, described Ukraine as “the most corrupt country on earth” and opened with the line “Old men profit and young men die”.
